title: Sit-to-Stand Tests — 5×STS and the 30-Second Chair Stand

hook.en: Standing up from a chair is a squat in disguise. Two short tests, one counting time and one counting repetitions, give you leg strength, endurance and falls risk with nothing more than a chair and a stopwatch.
hook.ur: Chair se uthna chhupa hua squat hai. Do mukhtasar tests, ek waqt aur doosra repetitions ginta hua, sirf ek chair aur stopwatch se aap ko taangon ki taqat, endurance aur girne ka khatra batate hain.

goal.en: By the end, you'll perform the five-times sit-to-stand (5×STS) and the 30-second chair stand, use the age norms and cut-offs and decide when to use each test.
goal.ur: End tak aap five-times sit-to-stand (5×STS) aur 30-second chair stand karenge, umar ke norms aur cut-offs use karenge aur tay karenge ke har test kab use karein.

text.en: **Five times sit-to-stand (5×STS):** seated on a standard chair (about 43 cm) with the arms folded across the chest, stand fully and sit down five times as fast as possible; the timer starts on "go" and stops when the buttocks touch the seat the fifth time. Norms: about **11 s at ages 60–69, 13 s in the 70s and 15 s in the 80s**; **over 15 s predicts recurrent falls**. **30-second chair stand:** the same position, count the full stands in 30 seconds; below-average scores for age (for example fewer than 12 for men and 10 for women aged 70–74) indicate a falls risk.
text.ur: **Five times sit-to-stand (5×STS):** standard chair (takriban 43 cm) par baithe hue, arms seene par fold, poora khara ho kar paanch baar jitni tezi se ho sake baith jayein; timer “go” par shuru aur paanchvi baar buttocks seat se lagte hi ruk jata hai. Norms: takriban **60–69 saal mein 11 s, 70s mein 13 s aur 80s mein 15 s**; **15 s se zyada baar baar girne ka khatra batata hai**. **30-second chair stand:** wohi position, 30 seconds mein poore stands ginein; umar ke hisaab se kam scores (maslan 70–74 saal mein mardon ke liye 12 se kam aur aurton ke liye 10 se kam) girne ka khatra batate hain.

text.en: A chair stand is a mini gym test of the legs. 5×STS is a sprint (how fast can you do 5?), the 30-second stand is a mini endurance test (how many can you do?). Both load the quadriceps and glutes with body weight, so the numbers tell you about leg power and the ability to "get up and go".
text.ur: Chair stand taangon ka chhota gym test hai. 5×STS sprint hai (5 kitni tezi se kar sakte hain?), 30-second stand chhota endurance test hai (kitne kar sakte hain?). Dono quadriceps aur glutes ko jism ke wazan se load karte hain, is liye numbers taangon ki taqat aur “uth kar chalne” ki salahiyat batate hain.

intro.en: Arms folded, feet flat, a 43 cm chair. The patient stands fully and sits five times; the counter shows the stand-ups and the timer the time. The healthy demo takes about 11 seconds, under the 15 s cut-off. Stop and restart if the arms are used.
intro.ur: Arms fold, pair flat, 43 cm chair. Patient poora khara hota hai aur paanch baar baithta hai; counter stand-ups aur timer waqt dikhata hai. Healthy demo takriban 11 seconds leta hai, 15 s cut-off se neeche. Arms use hon to ruk kar dobara shuru karein.

question.en: A 75-year-old needs 17 seconds for the five-times sit-to-stand. What does this mean?
question.ur: 75 saal ke patient ko five-times sit-to-stand ke liye 17 seconds lagte hain. Iska kya matlab hai?

text.en: Slower than the norm and above the 15 s cut-off: increased risk of recurrent falls; start lower-limb strengthening and balance work
text.ur: Norm se aahista aur 15 s cut-off se upar: baar baar girne ka barha khatra; lower-limb strengthening aur balance kaam shuru karein

feedback.en: Yes — over 15 s predicts recurrent falls in older adults; combine with other risk factors.
feedback.ur: Haan — 15 s se zyada buzurgon mein baar baar girne ka andaza deta hai; doosre risk factors ke saath milayein.

feedback.en: The norm for the 70s is about 13 s; 17 s is clearly slower.
feedback.ur: 70s ka norm takriban 13 s hai; 17 s wazeh taur par aahista hai.

text.ur: Tez, is liye girne ka khatra nahi

intro.en: Same seated position, arms folded. Count each **full** stand in 30 seconds and score the total. The demo shows 7 of 12 stand-ups at this point on the loop. A below-average score for age points to weak legs and a higher risk of falling.
intro.ur: Wohi baithi position, arms fold. 30 seconds mein har **poore** stand ko ginein aur total score karein. Demo loop ke is point par 12 mein se 7 stand-ups dikhata hai. Umar ke hisaab se kam score kamzor taangon aur girne ke zyada khatray ki taraf ishara karta hai.

rows.en: Time for five repetitions (speed and power)
rows.ur: Paanch repetitions ka waqt (speed aur power)
15 s se zyada baar baar girne ka andaza

rows.en: Below age norm, e.g. under 12 (men) and 10 (women) at 70–74
rows.ur: Umar ke norm se kam, maslan 70–74 mein 12 (mard) aur 10 (aurtein) se kam

rows.en: Quick screening, low-function patients, those who tire easily
rows.ur: Tez screening, kam function wale patients, jo jaldi thakte hain

rows.en: Community adults, tracking improvement over weeks
rows.ur: Community adults, hafton mein behtari track karna

rows.en: Floor effect in very frail patients (cannot do five)
rows.ur: Bohat kamzor patients mein floor effect (paanch nahi kar sakte)

rows.en: Ceiling effect in fit people; fatigue
rows.ur: Fit logon mein ceiling effect; thakan

text.en: **Letting the patient push off with the hands, or counting half-stands.** Arms must stay folded across the chest; if the hands are used, stop and restart (or record "arms used" and use a modified version). Count only **full** stands where the hips and knees reach full extension, and **full** sits where the buttocks touch the seat. Use a chair about 43 cm high against a wall so it cannot slide, and keep the same chair at each visit.
text.ur: **Patient ko haathon se dhakel kar uthne dena ya adhoori stands ginna.** Arms seene par fold rehni chahiye; haath use hon to ruk kar dobara shuru karein (ya “arms used” likhein aur modified version use karein). Sirf **poore** stands ginein jahan hips aur knees full extension tak pohnchein, aur **poori** baithak jahan buttocks seat se lagen. Takriban 43 cm unchi chair deewar ke saath rakhein taake sarak na jaye, aur har visit par wohi chair rakhein.

question.en: A patient uses their hands to push up on the third repetition of the 5×STS. What should you do?
question.ur: Patient 5×STS ki teesri repetition par haathon se zor lagata hai. Kya karein?

text.en: Stop, give the instruction again and restart; if the hands are always needed, record that the test could not be completed unaided
text.ur: Rok dein, hidayat dobara dein aur dobara shuru karein; haath hamesha chahiye hon to likhein ke test bina madad ke mukammal nahi ho saka

feedback.en: Yes — arm use changes the test; recording it is informative.
feedback.ur: Haan — arm ka istemal test badalta hai; likhna maloomati hai.

feedback.en: The time would not be comparable.

text.en: Count the repetition as half and carry on
text.ur: Repetition ko aadha ginein aur aage barhein

feedback.en: The standard rules do not allow half counts.
feedback.ur: Standard qaide aadhi ginti ki ijazat nahi dete.

text.en: **Use the test to shape and track training.** A slow 5×STS or low 30-second count points to leg weakness and poor power: prescribe progressive sit-to-stand practice (higher chair first, then lower, then add weight), step-ups and strength work two to three times per week. Track the change: an improvement of about **2.3 s for the 5×STS** or **2–3 more stands in 30 s** is meaningful in older adults. Combine with TUG and gait speed.
text.ur: **Test ko training ka rukh tay karne aur track karne ke liye use karein.** Aahista 5×STS ya kam 30-second ginti taangon ki kamzori aur kam power batati hai: progressive sit-to-stand practice (pehle unchi chair, phir neechi, phir wazan jorein), step-ups aur taqat ka kaam hafte mein do se teen baar prescribe karein. Tabdeeli track karein: buzurgon mein 5×STS mein takriban **2.3 s** ya 30 s mein **2–3 mazeed stands** ki behtari ahem hai. TUG aur gait speed ke saath milayein.

text.en: In healthy older adults the 5×STS norm rises from about 11.4 s at 60–69 to 14.8 s at 80–89 (Bohannon 2006). A time over 15 s predicts recurrent falls (Buatois 2008) and over 12 s is associated with sarcopenia screens. The 30-second chair stand has good reliability and validity for lower-limb strength (Jones 1999). Neither test is a diagnostic test; both are screening tools that guide training and monitor change.
text.ur: Healthy buzurgon mein 5×STS ka norm 60–69 mein takriban 11.4 s se 80–89 mein 14.8 s tak barhta hai (Bohannon 2006). 15 s se zyada waqt baar baar girne ka andaza deta hai (Buatois 2008) aur 12 s se zyada sarcopenia screens se jura hai. 30-second chair stand ki reliability aur validity lower-limb strength ke liye achi hai (Jones 1999). Koi bhi test diagnostic nahi; dono screening tools hain jo training ki rehnumai aur tabdeeli ki monitoring karte hain.

question.en: Why does a very frail patient who cannot complete five stands get no 5×STS time?
question.ur: Bohat kamzor patient jo paanch stands mukammal nahi kar sakta uska 5×STS waqt kyun nahi banta?

answer.en: That is a floor effect: the test cannot measure anything below its lowest level. Use a lower-demand alternative (a single sit-to-stand, the 30-second test with arm support, or a higher chair) and record how far the patient got. The inability itself is a strong marker of weakness.
answer.ur: Yeh floor effect hai: test apni sab se neechi satah se neeche kuch nahi naap sakta. Kam demand wala alternative (ek sit-to-stand, arm support ke saath 30-second test, ya unchi chair) use karein aur likhein ke patient kahan tak pohncha. Na kar paana khud kamzori ka mazboot marker hai.

question.en: Which score pattern suggests leg weakness rather than a poor balance problem?
question.ur: Kaun sa score pattern kharab balance ke bajaye taangon ki kamzori batata hai?

text.en: Slow 5×STS or low 30-second count with arms needed to push up
text.ur: Aahista 5×STS ya kam 30-second ginti jis mein uthne ke liye arms chahiye hon

feedback.en: Yes — sit-to-stand tests load the quadriceps and glutes, so slow performance with arm use points to weakness.
feedback.ur: Haan — sit-to-stand tests quadriceps aur glutes ko load karte hain, is liye arm use ke saath aahista karkardagi kamzori batati hai.

text.en: Normal 5×STS but frequent falls on uneven ground
text.ur: Normal 5×STS lekin hamwar na zameen par aksar girna

feedback.en: That suggests a balance or environmental problem.
feedback.ur: Yeh balance ya mahol ke masle ki taraf ishara hai.

text.en: A perfect score on every test

feedback.en: Perfect scores do not suggest weakness.
feedback.ur: Perfect scores kamzori ki taraf ishara nahi karte.

text.en: **Stop** the test for dizziness, chest pain, severe breathlessness, sudden pain in a joint, or loss of balance. Guard with a gait belt for frail patients, put the chair against a wall and keep feet flat. Avoid the test with an unhealed lower-limb fracture, a severe unstable condition or after recent surgery unless cleared.
text.ur: Test **rok dein** chakkar, seene ke dard, shadeed saans ki takleef, joint mein achanak dard ya balance khone par. Kamzor patients ke liye gait belt ke saath nigrani karein, chair deewar se laga dein aur pair flat rakhein. Unhealed lower-limb fracture, shadeed unstable halat ya haali surgery ke baad bina clearance ke test se bachein.

summary.en: 5×STS: five full stands as fast as possible, over 15 s predicts recurrent falls (norm about 11 s at 60–69, 13 s in the 70s, 15 s in the 80s).
summary.ur: 5×STS: paanch poore stands jitni tezi se ho sakein, 15 s se zyada baar baar girne ka andaza (norm 60–69 mein takriban 11 s, 70s mein 13 s, 80s mein 15 s).

summary.en: 30-second chair stand counts full stands: below-age-norm scores (for example under 12 in men and 10 in women at 70–74) indicate falls risk.
summary.ur: 30-second chair stand poore stands ginta hai: umar ke norm se kam scores (maslan 70–74 mein mardon mein 12 aur aurton mein 10 se kam) girne ka khatra batate hain.

summary.en: Standardise the chair and rules (arms folded, full stands), accept floor and ceiling effects and use the results to shape leg-strength training.
summary.ur: Chair aur qaide standardise karein (arms fold, poore stands), floor aur ceiling effects maanein aur results ko taangon ki taqat ki training ke liye use karein.

front.ur: 5×STS ka baar baar girne ka cut-off?

back.en: The number of full sit-to-stands in 30 seconds with arms folded; compare with age norms.
back.ur: Arms fold ke saath 30 seconds mein poore sit-to-stands ki ginti; umar ke norms se compare karein.

front.en: Standard chair height for the tests?
front.ur: Tests ke liye standard chair ki unchai?

back.en: About 43 cm (43–46 cm), against a wall.
back.ur: Takriban 43 cm (43–46 cm), deewar ke saath.

front.en: What do you do when the hands are used to push up?
front.ur: Haath dhakelne ke liye use hon to kya karte hain?

back.en: Stop and restart, or record that the test could not be completed unaided.
back.ur: Ruk kar dobara shuru karein, ya likhein ke test bina madad ke mukammal nahi hua.
